# `federal_register_docket_candidates`

**Federal Register normalized docket candidates (Layer 1)**

Physical typed child table (`federal_register_docket_candidates.parquet`) extracting normalized Regulations.gov docket candidates from each literal `docket_ids` label using SpicyDocs' shared plural docket normalizer (`normalize_docket_references` / `linked_docket_ids`), preserving both the zero-based `label_position` and zero-based `candidate_position` within multi-docket labels.

**Coverage.** Derived: every normalized Regulations.gov docket candidate extracted from `docket_ids` across `federal_register_documents` (from 1994-01-03 onward). *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** Extracted solely from printed `docket_ids` strings by syntax normalization; these candidate identifiers remain distinct from the publisher-stated Regulations.gov link in `federal_register_documents.regulations_dot_gov_info` and do not by themselves establish docket existence on regulations.gov. Labels yielding no Regulations.gov candidate produce zero rows here while remaining verbatim in `federal_register_documents.docket_ids`. Joins `federal_register_documents` on (`document_number`, `publication_date`) with native `DATE` equality; zero orphan rows are enforced on every build.

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_docket_candidates.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Parent document's reversible dated source identity (`document_number@YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Parent Federal Register document number; joins `federal_register_documents` with `publication_date`. |
| `publication_date` | `DATE` | Parent document's native `DATE` publication date; joins `federal_register_documents` with `document_number`. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained API page blob containing the parent document. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Parent document's JSON Pointer (`/results/<doc>`) inside the retained API page blob. |
| `label_position` | `INTEGER` | Zero-based ordinal position (`INTEGER`) of `label` in the parent document's `docket_ids` array. |
| `candidate_position` | `INTEGER` | Zero-based ordinal position (`INTEGER`) of `docket_id` among normalized candidates extracted from `label`. |
| `label` | `VARCHAR` | Literal printed docket label verbatim from `federal_register_documents.docket_ids`. |
| `docket_id` | `VARCHAR` | Normalized Regulations.gov docket identifier candidate returned by SpicyDocs' shared plural normalizer; distinct from `regulations_dot_gov_info.docket_id`. |
